auditType: builder source audit of normal queue eligibility and replay/recent selection; not browser acceptance

reportedRenderedSample.interpretation: bounded miss is compatible with the normal randomized queue; seven of 31 eligible words can remain outside the first 24 questions.

eligibility.restrictedProfileBehavior: sell is omitted if its graphemes s/e/l/ll are not all taught; this is the intended phonics gate.

seededProgressSimulation.method: Called createSpellingRun and the actual rememberBatch5LiteracyRun/getBatch5LiteracyProgress helpers with a temporary in-memory store; unlocked Chapter 2 through the completion helper; no browser, saved user profile, hidden state, or injection. Seeds were base + runIndex*7919 with base 1.

sourceConclusion: No selection regression found. The current 31-word band intentionally randomizes six fresh IDs per run while at least six unseen IDs remain. Four completed runs can contain 24 distinct words without sell; all eligible IDs are reachable by the sixth completed run. The reviewer stopped at the agreed 24-question cap, before the full 31-item pool cycle completed.
queueLifecycleCaveat: The UI records all six frozen run IDs when Start is pressed (AmariSpellingStudio.jsx:74-75), before the questions are individually answered. A player who repeatedly leaves a run early may reserve unseen questions in recent history. This audit did not find an indefinite-starvation case; the coverage guarantee above applies to normally completed runs.
existingTest: The meaningful six-question/repeat-avoidance test iterates seeded runs with the accumulated seen-ID set until every eligible word is observed; it includes the Chapter 2 pool and proves finite full-pool reachability.
limitations: This explains a possible 24-question miss; it does not recreate the reviewer’s exact seed history.
The independent 5399 run explicitly left sell-v2 rendered fit unverified because the card never appeared.
No rendered UI, sound, or profile mutation was performed in this source audit.
